Jill Biden's ex-husband kills wife: First $500000 fine, then life sentence awaits William Stevenson?
world news
Published on Feb 05, 2026 10:27 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
William Stevenson, 77, Jill Biden’s ex-husband, is charged with murdering his wife Linda after she was found unresponsive in their Delaware home. Held on $500,000 bail after a weeks-long probe, Stevenson once called Jill “bitter” and “nasty” in a 2024 TV rant. Jill Biden has declined to comment.
